summary: Of Southold on Long Island, father of Rachel Browne; John's 9th-great-grandfather.
bio: Jonathan Browne was born in 1653 and lived at Southold, Suffolk County, New York, where he died in 1710. He is recorded as the father of Rachel Browne, through whom he was John's 9th-great-grandfather. The 'brother Joseph Brown' named in John Tuthill III's will of 1740 was probably his son.
sources: [R4-S1] The Salmon Records: a private register of marriages and deaths of the residents of the town of Southold, 1696-1811 (NYG&B, 1918), full text searched (primary) https://archive.org/details/salmonrecordspri00salm
